title: Edge Cache Key: Unnormalized vs Normalized
description: Compare naive full-URL + Vary: User-Agent keys against normalized CDN edge cache keys.

before.label: Fragmented Key (Low Hit Ratio)
before.previewNote: Thousands of User-Agent permutations create redundant origin fetches.

after.label: Normalized Edge Key (High Hit Ratio)
after.code:
// Strip tracking params & normalize Vary
Key = host + path + sortParams(allow=['page','sort'])
Vary: Accept-Encoding
Cache-Control: public, s-maxage=3600, stale-while-revalidate=60
after.previewNote: Shared edge entry serves all visitors within milliseconds from nearest PoP.
